chapter: Return to New Orleans and Sharkey
title: Working many jobs a day with Sharkey for little money
summary: They talk about banana boat, radio, Blue Room and Famous Door jobs, long hours, and being cheated of the gate.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: How many jobs would you work a day with Sharky then?
Yeah, during the course of a day.
Well, like on a Saturday we'd wait at boats, see, banana boats. Mm-hmm. And, uh...
You mean like when people would be leaving on the boats?
Yeah, yeah, see. And, uh, then the radio program, I was once a week, then we'd have the jam session. On a Sunday, but we was off on Sundays, see.
What about the blue room? Did you work the blue room ever with Sharky?
Uh, yeah, we played the blue room. Oh, we played, uh, oh, but, uh, from the famous store we used to go to the blue room. But Smilin' and Joe, Smilin' and Joe used to fill in until we got back. Yeah.
That must have been a really hard job, though. Yeah, it was. You worked four and five jobs a day. Oh, yeah.
But we didn't get too much money, actually. I mean, you made $200 a week, you made plenty of money. That ain't no money, see, with all them jobs. Those jobs only was 10, 15 hours. That's ridiculous.
Oh, man. For the blue room and the boats and all that.
I'll tell you, we didn't make no money at all. We used to pack the auditorium upstairs. What was that, Cocoa Room?
Yeah, I know what you're talking about. Cocoa Room. Yeah.
We used to pack the place and, uh, we used to have 500 people and they said they have, uh, 40 people. Oh, I got gypped all around, see.
And you were working on percentage? I was.
The band was, uh, incorporated, see. Oh, I see. Hmm.
